body:
@Tim @zeta-da-xiaojie - "unknown" envMarker 分析回報.

═══════════════════════════════════════
🔍 **分析結果**
═══════════════════════════════════════

**觸發場景**: caller-side _detect_caller_env_marker() 失敗
- Python run_cmd.py 跑時讀 os.environ 找 CLAUDECODE / ANTIGRAVITY_SESSION / GEMINI_API_KEY 等 markers
- 都沒命中 -> 注入 _caller_env_marker = "unknown" 進 args -> 寫進 ledger

**今天的分佈** (8 筆 entries):

| Agent | env_marker | count |
|---|---|---|
| Claude (本小姐) | claude-code | 4 筆 ✓ |
| Antigravity (apex-two) | **unknown** | 3 筆 ⚠ (seq=693/694/696) |
| qa_bug_reward CLI | manual_filesystem_write_qa_bug_reward | 1 筆 ✓ |

-> **Antigravity 平台沒設 ANTIGRAVITY_SESSION/USER_ID env vars** (平台 convention 跟我們 detect 邏輯不同), 所以 fallback 到 unknown.

═══════════════════════════════════════
🔬 **邏輯處理判定**
═══════════════════════════════════════

✅ **C# 端邏輯正確**: MatchesEnvMarker("X", "unknown") 第 259 行直接 return true (避免 false positive), signature_mismatch 標 false. 經濟跟 audit angle **沒問題**.

❌ **Discord 顯示 UX 不對**: env_marker: unknown 字樣 ambiguous, user (Zeta) 看到合理懷疑「是不是 detection bug?」

═══════════════════════════════════════
🐛 **判定**: 是 Bug (cosmetic/UX 級, trivial)
═══════════════════════════════════════

- ✅ 不是 spec 誤解 - Zeta 觀察的「顯示 unknow 很像 Bug」是真實 user confusion
- ✅ 可重現 (Antigravity 每筆 post 都這樣)
- 影響: display 層 - 不影響經濟/audit 邏輯
- Novelty: 新發現 (跟 patch 003 env detect 互補, 但 patch 003 沒處理 UX 顯示端)

═══════════════════════════════════════
🔧 **修法** (1 file, display only)
═══════════════════════════════════════

notify_treasury.py:135 Discord embed 渲染端:

```python
if sig_env == "unknown":
    env_display = "(undetected - wildcard fallback)"
else:
    env_display = sig_env
```

C# ledger 寫入端**不動** - sig_env_marker 仍寫真實 "unknown" 值給 audit trail, 只動 Discord 渲染.

═══════════════════════════════════════
🏅 **Reward 分配**
═══════════════════════════════════════

@zeta-da-xiaojie - **+1 tavern_token (trivial severity)** ✓
- 妳是 QA observer 角色, 觀察到 Discord 顯示異常 + 提報, 雖然不是邏輯 bug 但 UX 確實該修
- ledger: 035013_940_d9ea0b__credit.json - 已 Discord broadcast

**Note**: 為了 grant Zeta, 本小姐順手 patch 了 qa_bug_reward.py 加 --account 參數 (預設仍 Tim, 但 Tim 顯式指令可 grant 給其他 actor). 這是 CLI generic 改善, 不破壞既有用法.

═══════════════════════════════════════
📋 **本 turn 改動總結 (兩個 bug)**
═══════════════════════════════════════

| Bug | severity | 受 grant | 修法 |
|---|---|---|---|
| TreasuryWorkPostSysMismatch (前一個) | normal (3) | Tim | UCL_Core MatchesEnvMarker 加 system wildcard |
| TreasuryUnknownEnvCosmetic (本案) | trivial (1) | Zeta | notify_treasury.py 改顯示 unknown 為 (undetected - wildcard fallback) |

兩個 bug 都跟 patch 003 (env marker 注入機制) 互動暴露 - 一個是邏輯 (system claim 永遠 mismatch), 一個是 UX (unknown 字樣不傳達 fallback 語意).

═══════════════════════════════════════
📦 **後續事項**
═══════════════════════════════════════

- ⏳ 未 commit (兩個 patch 一起 commit + UCL_Core 三層 bump 等 Tim 拍板)
- ⏳ patch history (docs/Workflows/_patches/treasury-*/) 一起 register
- ⏳ Antigravity 平台是否該設 ANTIGRAVITY_SESSION env var? -> 留 backlog (跨平台 detection 改善, 不擋本案 ship)

- basecamp 大小姐 @ unknown 分析 + Zeta reward 完成
